visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with her dark hair pulled back in a ponytail sits on a bright pink stool in a cluttered indoor home setting. She is wearing a beige long-sleeved shirt and a patterned scarf. She cradles a fluffy tan and white Corgi dog in her arms as if it were a baby; the dog has its mouth open and tongue out, looking relaxed and happy. Behind her, a world map is pinned to the wall, and to her left, a television screen displays news with various Chinese subtitles and a logo. In the foreground, the back of a man's head and his black puffer jacket are visible. (2) The scene cuts to a low-angle shot of the beige tiled floor where a Corgi dog is lying comfortably on its side. A man's hand enters the frame from the right side and gently pets the dog's head and neck. The dog appears very calm, with its eyes partially closed, enjoying the attention. In the background of this floor shot, a blue plastic trash can and several stacked green crates are visible near a wooden cabinet. (3) The camera cuts back to the initial scene showing the woman on the pink chair holding the Corgi. She is smiling and gently rocking the dog in her arms while talking. The dog maintains its upright, cradled posture, panting slightly and looking around the room. The lighting is consistent throughout, provided by bright indoor artificial lamps that illuminate the domestic objects and furniture in the background.
